# Present Simple

**[Apuntes de la clase](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Sg0hHRiVQsmWyQLj5QF6983AVbpGGFO-MIHna2Ib5UM/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.21ikvs6xxlcs)**

Present Simple [Learn all the Tenses in English: Complete Course](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O9S70oJAivI&t=1460s)

  
Se usa para hablar sobre acciones habituales o verdades generales.

It can be used to talk about common actions or general truths.
  
## To express permanent:

We live in New york 

He works at a bank

## Routines

I wake up at 6:00

I go to sleep  at 11:00

## Facts:

The sun rises in the east

## Schedules:

Our class starts at 9:00

The flight leaves at noon

## Frequency:

She always takes the bus

## Spelling


| Most verbs                      | Add S          | Dance => dances<br><br>Cook => cooks<br><br>Sleep => sleeps                      |
| ------------------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Verbs ending in S, SH, CH, X    | Add ES         | Kiss => kisses<br><br>Wash => washes<br><br>Teach => teaches<br><br>Fix => fixes |
| Verbs ending in consonant and Y | Drop Y add IES | Study => studies<br><br>Try => tries                                             |
| others                          |                | Go => goes<br><br>Do => does<br><br>Have => has                                  |

## Short answers

**Do they need help?

Yes, they do

No, they don’t

  

**Does he speak French?

Yes, he does

No, he doesn’t

  

**Do you like this song?

Yes, I do

No, I don’t

  
## Common errors

### Tense:

I am living in Tokyo (incorrect)

I’m live in Tokyo (correct)


### Verb:

We likes to travel ❌

We like to travel ☑️

  
### Form:

They doesn’t eat vegetables ❌

They don’t eat vegetables☑️


Does you talk to him often? ❌

Do you talk to him often? ☑️

  
### Spelling:

She trys to save money❌

She tries to save money ☑️

  
### Missing words:

What time you finish work?❌

What time do you finish work? ☑️

# Present Continuous or Present Progressive

[Learn all the Tenses in English: Complete Course](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O9S70oJAivI&t=1460s)


you can describe the action occurring in the present moment

  

![](data:image/png;base64,) 

  
## Structure

|               | Structure                                                      | Example            |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| Affirmative   | Subject + Verb to be (am , is, are) + main verb + ING          | I am studying      |
| Negative      | Subject + Verb to be (am not, isn’t, aren’t) + main verb + ING | She isn't reading. |
| Interrogative | Verb to be (am, is, are) + subject + main verb + ING           | Are they playing   |

## When to use it

- **Now:**
	- The baby is sleeping

- **Around now:**
	- He is writing a book

- **Temporary:**
	- We are staying at a hotel

- **Trend:**
	- The prices are homes are increasing

- **Repeated action:**
	- They are always making noise(negative)
 
- **Future:**
	- She’s flying to Mexico next week.

## When not to use it

### Permanent:

- I am living in Canada ❌

- I am working at ABC company ❌

  
### Stative Verbs:

- I am understanding English❌

- We are liking this show ❌

- They are having a  car ❌

- Are you needing help? ❌

## Contractions

| Without contractions | With a contractions | verb+ING |
| -------------------- | ------------------- | -------- |
| I am                 | I’m                 | learning |
| You are              | you’re              | learning |
| We are               | we’re               | learning |
| They are             | They’re             | learning |
| He is                | He’s                | learning |
| She is               | She’s               | learning |
| It is                | It’s                | learning |

| Negative             |                            |          |
| -------------------- | -------------------------- | -------- |
| Without contractions | With a contractions        | verb+ING |
| I am not             | I’m  not                   | watching |
| You are not          | You’re not \| you aren’t   | watching |
| We are not           | We’re not \| we aren’t     | watching |
| They are not         | They’re not \| they aren’t | watching |
| He is not            | He’s not \| he isn’t       | watching |
| She is not           | She’s not \| she isn’t     | watching |
| It is not            | It’s not \| It isn’t       | watching |

## Spelling

| Most verbs          | Add ING                 | Eat => eating<br><br>Walk=> walking   |
| ------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Verbs ending in E   | Drop E and add ING      | Use => using<br><br>Take => taking    |
| Verbs ending in IE  | Drop IE and add Y + ING | Lie=> lying<br><br>Tie => tying       |
| Verbs ending in CVC | Double last letter      | Clap => clapping<br><br>Sit=> sitting |
## Short answers

Question: Is he working late?

- Yes,  he is
    
- No, he isn’t

Question: Are they going to the meeting?

- Yes, they are
    
- No, they aren’t
 
Question: Are you studying?

- Yes, I am
    
- No, I’m not

## Common Errors


To be missing: 

- My brother watching the news.❌

- My brother is watching the news ✅
  
- John helping ❌

- John is not helping ✅

- She going? ❌

- Is she going? ✅
   
To be incorrect:

- Bob and Maria is driving home ❌

- Bob and Maria are driving home ✅

- He aint studying ❌

- He isn’t studying ✅

Verb incorrect:

- She is do her homework ❌

- She is doing her homework ✅

- The game is start now ❌

- The game is starting now ✅

Spelling:

- She’s lieing / siting / writing ❌

- She’s lying / sitting / writing ✅
 
- Were going to the mall ❌

- We’re going to the mall ✅

Stative verbs:

- I am needing some water ❌

- I need some water ✅
 
- I am wanting to visit Hawaii ❌

- I want to visit Hawaii ✅

Permanent:

- We are manufacturing cars ❌

- We manufacture cars ✅
